title: Context window
caption: The context window Shared visual with every toolbar option switched on, as a reference.

controls.description: The toolbar holds the part chips (drag to reorder), Technical, download and upload; the heads hold the 200K | 1M switch, the smart-zone toggle, the usage readout, each part's own Technical toggle and the Attention menu. A real Slide picks a Preset that shows only what it needs.

walkthrough.title: Walkthrough
walkthrough.script: This is the context window with every control on. Point at the toolbar first, then at each part's head, and name what each control does before you pick a smaller Preset for a real Slide.
